name: navigation-menu
title: Navigation Menu
description: Top-level site navigation with flyout panels, a shared animated viewport, an optional indicator and link styles, built on Reka UI.

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { NavigationMenuRootEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { NavigationMenuProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { NavigationMenuRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import NavigationMenuViewport from './NavigationMenuViewport.vue'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<NavigationMenuProps>(), {
  viewport: true,
})
const emits = defineEmits<NavigationMenuRootEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class', 'viewport')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <NavigationMenuRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="navigation-menu"
    :data-viewport="props.viewport"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('group/navigation-menu relative z-10 flex max-w-max flex-1 items-center justify-center', props.class)"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
    <NavigationMenuViewport v-if="props.viewport" />
  </NavigationMenuRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { NavigationMenuContentEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { NavigationMenuContentProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { NavigationMenuContent, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const props = defineProps<NavigationMenuContentProps>()
const emits = defineEmits<NavigationMenuContentEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <NavigationMenuContent
    data-slot="navigation-menu-content"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(
      'p-2 data-[motion^=from-]:animate-[elf-fade-in_150ms_ease-out] data-[motion^=to-]:animate-[elf-fade-out_150ms_ease-in_forwards] motion-reduce:animate-none!',
      'group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:absolute group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:top-full group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:left-0 group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:z-50 group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:mt-1.5 group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:overflow-hidden group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:rounded-md group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:border group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:bg-popover group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:text-popover-foreground group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:shadow-md group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:data-[state=open]:animate-[elf-zoom-in_120ms_ease-out] group-data-[viewport=false]/navigation-menu:data-[state=closed]:animate-[elf-fade-out_100ms_ease-in_forwards]',
      props.class,
    )"
  >
    <slot />
  </NavigationMenuContent>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { NavigationMenuIndicatorProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { NavigationMenuIndicator, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const props = defineProps<NavigationMenuIndicatorProps>()
const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
</script>

<template>
  <NavigationMenuIndicator
    data-slot="navigation-menu-indicator"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(
      'top-full z-1 flex h-2 items-end justify-center overflow-hidden data-[orientation=horizontal]:absolute data-[orientation=horizontal]:left-(--reka-navigation-menu-indicator-position) data-[orientation=horizontal]:w-(--reka-navigation-menu-indicator-size) data-[state=hidden]:animate-[elf-fade-out_100ms_ease-in_forwards] data-[state=visible]:animate-[elf-fade-in_150ms_ease-out] motion-reduce:animate-none!',
      props.class,
    )"
  >
    <div class="relative top-[60%] size-2 rotate-45 rounded-tl-sm border-t border-l bg-popover shadow-md" />
  </NavigationMenuIndicator>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { NavigationMenuItemProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { NavigationMenuItem, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const props = defineProps<NavigationMenuItemProps>()
const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
</script>

<template>
  <NavigationMenuItem
    data-slot="navigation-menu-item"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('relative', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </NavigationMenuItem>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { NavigationMenuLinkEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { NavigationMenuLinkProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { NavigationMenuLink, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { navigationMenuItemLinkClass, navigationMenuTriggerStyle } from './styles'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<NavigationMenuLinkProps>(), {
  variant: 'item',
})
const emits = defineEmits<NavigationMenuLinkEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class', 'variant')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <NavigationMenuLink
    data-slot="navigation-menu-link"
    :data-variant="props.variant"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(props.variant === 'trigger' ? navigationMenuTriggerStyle() : navigationMenuItemLinkClass, props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </NavigationMenuLink>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { NavigationMenuListProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { NavigationMenuList, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const props = defineProps<NavigationMenuListProps>()
const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
</script>

<template>
  <NavigationMenuList
    data-slot="navigation-menu-list"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('group flex flex-1 list-none flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-1', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </NavigationMenuList>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { NavigationMenuTriggerProps } from './index'
import { ChevronDown } from '@lucide/vue'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { NavigationMenuTrigger, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { navigationMenuTriggerStyle } from './styles'

const props = defineProps<NavigationMenuTriggerProps>()
const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
</script>

<template>
  <NavigationMenuTrigger
    data-slot="navigation-menu-trigger"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(navigationMenuTriggerStyle(), props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
    <ChevronDown
      class="relative top-px ml-0.5 size-3 transition-transform duration-200 group-data-[state=open]/navigation-trigger:rotate-180 motion-reduce:transition-none"
      aria-hidden="true"
    />
  </NavigationMenuTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { NavigationMenuViewportProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { NavigationMenuViewport, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<NavigationMenuViewportProps>(), {
  align: 'start',
})
const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
</script>

<template>
  <NavigationMenuViewport
    data-slot="navigation-menu-viewport"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(
      'absolute top-full left-(--reka-navigation-menu-viewport-left) mt-1.5 h-(--reka-navigation-menu-viewport-height) w-(--reka-navigation-menu-viewport-width) max-w-[calc(100vw-1.25rem)] origin-top overflow-hidden rounded-md border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-md data-[state=closed]:animate-[elf-fade-out_100ms_ease-in_forwards] data-[state=open]:animate-[elf-zoom-in_120ms_ease-out] motion-reduce:animate-none!',
      props.class,
    )"
  />
</template>
